cues.text: The south road out of Brindle Cross. Four strangers, one mile, and no agreement yet on who walks in front.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Mossfoot. Why's a card player walking an empty road?

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Big Man! You do talk to me. I was starting to think you only spoke to goblins and onions.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Truth is, I once walked the whole width of the Vael for a bet. Roads are where the good stories are.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: That's not an answer.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: It's a story. Better than an answer. Lasts longer.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: 'Brindle Cross, one mile. Fort Harrow, thirty-nine.' It is thirty-eight and a half. Someone carved this in a hurry.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Thirty-nine miles. Two days' march. Less, with nobody arguing.
Past the bend, the birds have stopped singing. The grass around the dark lantern is the colour of old ash.

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Listen. No birds past the bend. And the grass has gone grey. In daylight.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: Fringe Unlight. Halbrecht's Lantern Theory, the 1002 edition, says it takes days to gather. It has been one night.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Lovely. Let's go and stand in it.
Lantern Thirty-Seven. Its glass is grey and furred with frost, though the afternoon sun is warm on everyone's back.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: The Order issues every inspector a housing key. It is in here. Somewhere. Between the almanac and my spare quills.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Professor, may I? It's a catch, not a riddle.
Tamsin breathes on her fingers, slides a hairpin under the frosted catch, and leans. For a long moment, nothing. Then it gives.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: There. Stubborn little thing. And somebody's been in here before me.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: See the scratches round the catch? Fresh. Someone opened this lately, and not with a key.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: You did that in less time than it takes me to find a key. I am writing that down.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Write down that I'm charming.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: I will write down that you are practised.
Ilsevel leans into the open housing, close enough that her breath frosts on the glass.
The cradle inside is empty. No shards in the grass, no crack in the glass. Whatever burned here was lifted out whole.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: It was not broken. It was taken. Lifted out of its cradle like an egg from a nest.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: Who did it, or how, this housing will not tell me. I have read every book on lantern-craft in the Hall. None of them covers theft.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Goblins. The goblin said they carry the stones.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: Goblins who open a Lamplighter housing without a key. Technically possible. I do not like it.
Oriel lays her palm flat against the iron post. It is cold enough to ache.

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Aurelan, keep the light. Keep the road. Keep...
She waits for the warmth that has always answered her. It does not come. Oriel takes her hand away.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Oriel?

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: It's cold. That's all. It's only cold.
The sun slides down behind the field. Where the dark trail leaves the road, Brannoc goes down on one knee.
The earth has been trodden to mud by many feet, over and over. Brannoc reads it three ways and believes none of them.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Goblins. Some. Last night, or last week. Can't tell.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Ground's been walked to soup. Could be four. Could be forty.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Forty. Lovely. My favourite number of goblins is none.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: It will be fully dark within the hour. I would like that noted before anyone decides anything.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: And goblins like the dark. Noted twice.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: That's where they went.

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Then that's where the light went too. Brannoc, in front?

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Single file. Behind me.
Behind them, the road still holds the last of the light. Ahead, the Thornpike Woods are already night.
Somebody starts to hum a hymn, very quietly and not very well.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Sunshine. Are you singing?

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Only when I'm nervous. Keep walking.

next_time: Night falls in the Thornpike Woods.
